name: Proper Ordered Sample Compression of the Three-Code Class
proof: Use the order $000<011<101$.  The order-compression construction retaining nothing for $000$, $x_0=1$ for $011$, and $x_2=1$ for $101$ decodes only to these three class members, so it is proper and has size one.  A size-zero scheme has one fixed proper reconstruction and cannot be consistent with both full samples $000$ and $011$.
